subject: ArcadiaWorks connectivity rehearsal and partner validation cadence
messages:

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: ArcadiaWorks — initial integration details and infra diagram

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for taking time last week. Attached is a compact infra diagram and a short security profile so your infra team can validate network requirements. Our goal for the week of Mar 8 is a lightweight connectivity rehearsal (no production traffic) to exercise the prefix/KV caching and egress patterns when we route through your dedicated pool.

Top asks from our side:
- Accept a short VPN peering/temporary IP allowlist for 72 hours.
- A test API token and an echo endpoint that returns latency+hostname headers.
- A quick smoke plan to confirm model variant fallback (gpt-open-quant vs gpt-open-fp16).

I attached: arcadia-infra-diagram.pdf and arcadia-security-profile.txt.

Can you confirm an approximate 2-hour window for a rehearsal and point me to the runbook you'll be following?

Best,
Pascal Meyer
Director, Integrations – ArcadiaWorks
pascal.meyer@arcadiaworks.com
+1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: ArcadiaWorks — initial integration details and infra diagram

Pascal —

Appreciate the diagram and security summary. We can run a 90–120 minute connectivity rehearsal the week of Mar 8. Proposal: Thu Mar 10 14:00–16:00 PT as the primary window, Tue Mar 8 10:00–12:00 PT as a rehearsal if you prefer an earlier smoke. Action items we need from ArcadiaWorks before the window:

1) Temporary allowlist CIDR(s) / VPN details (we can take a 72-hour tunnel).
2) A test token scoped to "partner:rehearsal" with example payload patterns (we'll mirror request shapes).
3) Any request size/sequence length distribution you can share so we can configure batching/kv cache thresholds.

I've attached a short partner-validation-matrix.xlsx that maps what we'll verify during the rehearsal (connectivity, routing, fallback, KV cache hit rates, token accounting).

Runbook link: https://app.redwoodinference.com/runbooks/arcadia-connectivity-rehearsal (internal access control).

I'll loop in Vivek for the dedicated pool config and Lauren for acceptance gating; Vivek, Lauren — can you confirm who will own the routing policy and whether we should pre-configure a model fallback route to the quantized variant?

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArcadiaWorks — initial integration details and infra diagram

Sergio,

Thanks — Tue Mar 8 10:00–12:00 PT works better for us; we want to keep Thu as a fallback. We will provide the temporary tunnel details by EOD Fri (Mar 4). For sequence length distribution: ~70% short queries (<128 tokens), 25% conversational (~512 tokens), 5% long form (>1024) during the rehearsal.

We'd appreciate if Redwood can pre-configure a fallback to the quantized variant (gpt-open-quant) when latency > 1.1s or node saturation hits 85%. Also, can you surface a per-route token cost estimate ahead of the rehearsal so our finance/ops team aren't surprised?

Attaching a quick security note (arcadia-security-profile.txt) with our compliance officer's contact.

Looking forward — Pascal

- Prep a dedicated temporary route and pre-seed model-fallback rule: primary gpt-open-fp16, fallback gpt-open-quant with throttling policy.
- Provision a short-lived API token (TTL 72h) scoped to partner:rehearsal and post it to the runbook.
- Validate that our KV prefix caching behaves for the ~70% short queries (we should target cache TTL=30s for rehearsal).
- Capture per-route cost estimate (estimate spreadsheet attached).

Vivek — can you pre-create the dedicated pool entry and mark capacity reserved for 2 tokens/s burst at test window? Lauren — I'll need an acceptance checklist and a canary rollback policy in case fallback causes correctness regressions. Grace — want ops on standby for quick routing changes.

Pascal —

All set for Tue Mar 8 10:00–12:00 PT (we'll start the rehearsal with a short check-in at 09:50 to confirm tunnels). Summary of what we've provisioned:

- Temporary VPN endpoint: 35.198.77.22 (72h allowlist).
- Test token posted to runbook: partner-rehearsal-token (visible to your integration address).
- Dedicated pool reserved: 2 tokens/s baseline, burst to 5 tokens/s for 10m windows.
- Fallback policy: latency > 1.1s OR avg CPU > 85% -> route to gpt-open-quant (with canary 5% traffic ramp and auto-rollback on accuracy drift > 2%).
